_comment: circuit-agent configuration — edit these values before starting

api._note: Public CIRCUIT API. Self-hosters: change to http://localhost:18960 and set CIRCUIT_INTERNAL_KEY in .env to bypass payment.

strategy._strategy_note: buyCooldownMinutes: skip re-entry on the same mint for this many minutes after closing a position. paperTrading: true enables paper mode — no real swaps, free data sources only. paperSolBalance: starting virtual SOL for paper mode. deadMoneyMinutes/deadMoneyRangePct/deadMoneyMinHoldMinutes: exit early if pnl stays within ±deadMoneyRangePct for deadMoneyMinutes (after holding at least deadMoneyMinHoldMinutes). minHoldBeforeTpMinutes/minHoldBeforeSlMinutes: suppress TP/SL exits within this many minutes after entry to prevent phantom exits from price-feed lag.
strategy._tuning_note_2026_06_18: S1 requireEntryConfirm: re-read live price right before buy, abort if it faded > entryConfirmMaxFadePct below the scan price (kills stale-bounce fills, the 73%-never-green root cause). S3 bounceScoreMode 'modest' stops rewarding big (exhausted) 5m bounces; 'magnitude' = legacy curve. S2 requireFreshBounce (default false): gate on the 1m turn still advancing — left OFF to collect bounceFresh vs outcomes first (see entryConditions in trade_history). S5 hardStopMultiple: below stopLossPct*this, exit immediately without the Jupiter-defer that let fast dumps gap to -10%.

circuit._note: Agent will warn when CIRCUIT balance drops below this (for API payment top-up)

risk._note: maxTop5HolderPct: skip tokens where the top-5 wallets control more than this fraction of total supply. Backtested at +17pp win rate improvement — tokens above 30% showed 80% stop-loss rate in swarm history.

llm._note: provider: 'openrouter' (cloud) or 'ollama' (local). baseUrl overrides provider default. openrouterKey or OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var.

survival._note: Warn when SOL < minSolWarning. Pause new buys when SOL < minSolPause. circuitReinvestPct: fraction of each profit used to buy CIRCUIT (0.40 = 40%). Raised from 0.25 — at 27% win rate and 0.005 SOL entries, 25% reinvest was insufficient to rebuild CIRCUIT balance faster than API calls drained it.

reflect._note: Self-improvement loop interval (default 4h). autoApply: true = auto-apply suggested config changes within safe bounds. Enabled — the reflect loop's suggestions (minLiquidity 75k→80k, minScanScore adjustments) were correct but never applied because this was false.

telegram._note: Set token here OR in TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var. heartbeatChatId = your Telegram user ID to receive heartbeat messages.

heartbeat._note: intervalMs: proactive check-in cadence (default 5 min, 0 to disable). contextRefreshMs: how often to refresh cached SOL price + Fear & Greed index (default 30 min).

swarm._note: autoPublish: emit buy/sell signals automatically on trade execution. minReputationToFollow: only factor signals from agents above this reputation score (0-100). consensusBoostFactor: scale entry size when swarm consensus agrees (e.g. 1.2 = 20% larger). consensusBoostMinScore: independent score must reach this before the boost applies (null = minScanScore+10). blacklistVerifyTopN: re-verify swarm blacklist entries against RugCheck for the top N scored candidates before filtering — prevents hallucinated blacklist entries from silently dropping good trades. S6 diversityWindow: each agent deterministically picks from the top-N candidates within diversityScoreBand points of the best (and above minScanScore), seeded by agentId, so the swarm spreads across tokens instead of all piling into scored[0] (≤1 disables). diversityScoreBand: score points below the top still eligible for diversity selection.

agentLoop._note: How often the agent reasons about and updates its session strategy (default 90 min). The LLM tunes patternFilter/minScore for the next window. defaultMode pins the trading mode (operator preference) — the LLM may still narrow patternFilter/minScore but cannot switch out of this mode; remove this key to hand mode control back to the LLM. Modes: active (auto-buy best scorer), selective (LLM gate per candidate), watchOnly (scan only, no buys).

dashboard._note: Local web dashboard at http://localhost:18800 (loopback only — use SSH tunnel for remote access). apiKey: require x-api-key header on all API routes. allowCors: explicit origin to allow (e.g. 'http://localhost:3000') — leave empty to disable CORS entirely.
